## Background

<!-- CHANGE THIS -->

I am a Master of City Planning student at the University of Pennsylvania, concentrating in Transportation Planning. Before coming to Penn, I studied Parks and Recreation Management, Human Geography, and Urban and Rural Planning.

My interests include transportation planning, spatial analysis, and the use of data to understand cities and communities. Through my coursework and planning experience, I have worked with demographic, transportation, and spatial data to examine issues such as accessibility, mobility, and the built environment.

I am interested in developing stronger skills in urban spatial analysis and using these tools to support data-informed planning and policy decisions.
